चक्रवात ‘अर्नब’ को लेकर रेलवे ने जारी की एडवाइजरी:ट्रेन की स्थिति देखकर ही घर से निकलें, फिसलन वाले जगहों पर संभलकर चलने की सलाह
- कॉपी लिंक
चक्रवात ‘अर्नब’ के असर से छत्तीसगढ़ के कुछ हिस्सों में 28 और 29 अक्टूबर को भारी से अति भारी बारिश और तेज हवाएं चलने की संभावना है। मौसम विभाग की चेतावनी को देखते हुए दक्षिण पूर्व मध्य रेलवे ने यात्रियों के लिए एडवाइजरी जारी की है। रेलवे ने यात्रियों से अपील की है कि यात्रा शुरू करने से पहले ट्रेन की स्थिति की जानकारी लें और खराब मौसम के दौरान सावधानी बरतें।
रेलवे ने यात्रियों को सलाह दी है कि, स्टेशन के लिए घर से निकलने से पहले अपनी ट्रेन के चलने की ताजा स्थिति जरूर पता कर लें। खराब मौसम के कारण सड़क यातायात प्रभावित हो सकता है। ऐसे में पर्याप्त समय लेकर स्टेशन पहुंचें, ताकि यात्रा के दौरान परेशानी न हो।
रेलवे की सूचनाओं पर ध्यान दें
यात्रियों को ट्रेन संचालन से जुड़ी जानकारी देने के लिए स्टेशनों पर उद्घोषणा, सूचना बोर्ड और डिजिटल स्क्रीन का इस्तेमाल किया जा रहा है। रेलवे के आधिकारिक सोशल मीडिया माध्यमों से भी जरूरी सूचनाएं दी जाएंगी। ट्रेन रद्द होने, रास्ता बदलने या संचालन में बदलाव की जानकारी के लिए रेलवे के आधिकारिक माध्यमों पर ही भरोसा करें।
प्लेटफॉर्म और सीढ़ियों पर रहें सावधान
बारिश के कारण प्लेटफॉर्म, फुट ओवरब्रिज और सीढ़ियों पर फिसलन हो सकती है। रेलवे ने यात्रियों से इन जगहों पर संभलकर चलने और रेलवे ट्रैक पार नहीं करने की अपील की है। यात्रियों को निर्धारित यात्री क्षेत्रों में रहने और रेलवे कर्मचारियों के निर्देशों का पालन करने कहा गया है।
मोबाइल चार्ज रखें, जरूरी सामान साथ रखें
रेलवे ने यात्रियों को मोबाइल फोन चार्ज रखने के साथ जरूरी दवाइयां, पीने का पानी और आपातकालीन संपर्क नंबर साथ रखने की सलाह दी है। रेलवे प्रशासन ने कहा है कि खराब मौसम के दौरान सतर्क रहें और सुरक्षा संबंधी निर्देशों का पालन करें, ताकि यात्रा सुरक्षित बनी रहे।

Cyclone Arnab’s impact, yellow alert in 27 Rajasthan districts today:Rain intensifies cold; day and night temperatures drop to 10°C
Storm 'Arnab', which formed over the Bay of Bengal, has begun affecting Rajasthan. According to the Meteorological Department, 27 districts could receive heavy rain today.
On Wednesday, clouds gathered over areas in the Bharatpur and Kota divisions late in the evening, and some places received light rain late at night. The change in weather also led to a sudden increase in the chill across the state.
Over the past 24 hours, temperatures in almost all cities, including Jaipur, Pilani, Sikar, Barmer and Churu, fell by up to 2 degrees.
On Wednesday, no city other than Barmer recorded a maximum temperature above 35 degrees Celsius. Meanwhile, night temperatures have fallen to as low as 10 degrees.
Major weather updates
Sirohi-Sikar record the most intense cold: Sirohi recorded the coldest daytime conditions on Wednesday, with the maximum temperature at 29.4°C. Barmer was the hottest area, where the temperature was recorded at 36.3°C.
Sikar experienced the coldest night of the season, with the minimum temperature falling to 10°C. According to the Meteorological Department, temperatures are likely to fall further due to rain.
Storm impact to continue until 31 October: According to the Meteorological Department, the Arnab storm may affect Rajasthan for three days. Its impact will be greatest today and tomorrow.
The impact is expected to begin weakening on 31 October. Strong winds may accompany the rain over the three days.
What the weather will be like ahead
Weather conditions in Rajasthan's major districts
Jaipur: The sky remained clear, and the sun shone throughout Wednesday. As the sunshine was less intense, the temperature fell.
The maximum temperature here was recorded at 31.6°C and the minimum at 18.7°C. Earlier, Jaipur experienced a slight chill at night, making it the coldest night at the start of this season.
The weather remained clear throughout the day in Jaipur. Daytime temperatures have been falling in the capital over the past few days.
Alwar: The weather remained normal from Wednesday morning onwards. It was sunny in the afternoon, but the heat was less intense. The weather felt cooler in the morning and evening.
The Meteorological Department has forecast rain in Alwar on 29 and 30 October. As a result, the weather may change over the next two days.
A decline in both daytime and night-time temperatures has been recorded in Alwar for the past three days.
Udaipur: The maximum temperature here was recorded at 31.2°C and the minimum at 16°C. Night-time temperatures have been falling steadily. Meanwhile, the heat during the day has also started to ease.

Kota: The weather remained normal throughout the day. There was no change in the daytime temperature. However, the night-time temperature fell by 2 degrees.
The minimum temperature was recorded at 16.8°C, while the maximum temperature was 32.7°C. The fall in the minimum temperature has led to a slight chill being felt in the mornings and evenings.
The mercury is also continuing to fall in Kota. Rain is likely in the coming days.
Ajmer: The maximum temperature was recorded at 31.7°C and the minimum at 16.9°C on Wednesday. The cold has begun to intensify in the city at night, while the heat is less noticeable during the day.
The effect of sunlight was weaker in Ajmer on Wednesday. There was also a slight decline in the temperature here.
Jodhpur: The district recorded a maximum temperature of 34.2 degrees Celsius, which was 0.4 degrees below normal. The minimum temperature was 20.4 degrees Celsius, which was 3 degrees above normal.
The drop in temperature has made the weather pleasant in the city during the morning and evening, while nights have begun to feel slightly colder.
The weather has also started to change in Jodhpur in the last days of October. It has become colder here during the day and at night.
Sikar: The temperature last night fell by around 2 degrees. The sun came out in Sikar as the weather remained clear throughout the day, but the effect of the cold winds continued during the day as well.
The maximum temperature was recorded at 31.0 degrees and the minimum at 10.8 degrees. Light rain is likely in Sikar on 29 October.
The temperature also dropped in Sikar. The cold intensified because of chilly winds.
